description: Defines mock ViewModel classes for design-time data in the Calculator application's unit converter, used exclusively in debug builds for UI design purposes.

classes.name: CategoryViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for UI category representation with name and visibility properties.

classes.name: UnitViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for measurement units with name and abbreviation.

classes.name: UnitConverterSupplementaryResultViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for supplementary conversion results including value and unit.

classes.name: UnitConverterViewModel
classes.description: Main ViewModel aggregating categories, units, and conversion data for design-time UI rendering.
